name: causal-A-and-B-selection
freeze: before any causal training or decoded validation

phase_student.teacher: per-frame phase_wide oracle on classical causal state; noncausal labels only; teacher choices never synthesized into input history
phase_student.source: same speaker-disjoint train/validation corpus and augmentation asA; no test inputs
phase_student.loss: eligible frames only; mean squared log gain ratio (SV13 bands) +0.1 smoothL1(phase/8,target_phase/8) +0.01 mean(gain-1)^2 +0.001 mean(phase/8)^2; equal language weight
phase_student.compact_gain_export: if distill_gain selected, final17th weight/scale/bias row can be dropped; bit-exact paired native parity required before acceptance

pool: the stageA validation-selected admitted candidate, if any
admission: complete finite native decoded validation; per language waveform ratio<1, fullband envelope ratio<=1, mean ESTOI delta>=0 vsclassical PLC
ranking: maximize minimum EN/SV mean ESTOI delta
minimize sum EN/SV fullband envelope ratios
prefer fewer outputs on exact tie
holdout: freeze12 LibriSpeech test-clean speakers/utterances and12 RixVox speakers before training; no test audio or metrics before final selection
acceptance: only the single validation-selected causal candidate; stageA full12/24/32kbps,10/20ms,2mode,3condition,6pattern matrix and all frozen guards; no fallback or retune after test
production: retain installed model unless independent acceptance and native no-allocation/parity/CPU checks pass
limits: English independent acceptance is native16kHz LibriSpeech; native48kHz VCTK is covered in validation, not a new independent highband speaker test
speaker identity proof uses published corpus IDs; baseline FLEURS overlap cannot be audited
one distillation objective does not prove a causal or architecture ceiling
